snippet.title: Gemaze TD - Trailer 1
snippet.description:
PLAY FOR FREE ON ITCH.IO, SEARCH "GEMAZE TD"

Inspired by the Gem TD map from Warcraft 3. Gemaze is a tower defense where you build the maze / path for the enemy waves. You can create lots of different gem combinations that will help you scale your DPS and beat the game.
